## Needs Decision: 2026-10-21 — R1-tests Fix the Roborazzi screenshot tests failing on Windows (Re-opened R1)
### Question: كيف نجعل `./gradlew test` أخضر على جهازك (Windows) مرة أخرى؟
### Root cause (confirmed this run): the JAR Robolectric 4.11.1 resolves, `~/.gradle/caches/.../org.robolectric/nativeruntime-dist-compat/1.0.2/nativeruntime-dist-compat-1.0.2.jar`, contains only
  `native/linux/x86_64/librobolectric-nativeruntime.so`, `native/mac/aarch64/…dylib`, `native/mac/x86_64/…dylib` — **no `native/windows/`** ⇒ `robolectric-nativeruntime.dll not found`.
### Options:
  (أ) **رفع Robolectric** `4.11.1` → إصدار أحدث فيه native runtime لـ Windows (يُعتقد أنه 4.12+؛ لم يُتحقّق منه بلا شبكة). هذا تغيير في إصدار dependency، ويعيد تنزيل الـ artifacts، وقد يغيّر pixels الـ baselines ⇒ `recordRoborazziDevDebug` + مراجعة مرئية.
  (ب) **OS guard** في `HomeScreenScreenshotTest.kt` و `SettingsLayoutScreenshotTest.kt`: نضيف إلى `assumeTrue(BuildConfig.DEBUG)` الموجود شرط `!System.getProperty("os.name").startsWith("Windows")` ⇒ الاختبارات السبعة تُتخطّى (skipped) على Windows وتعمل على Linux/macOS/CI. التغيير يخصّ الاختبارات فقط ولا يمسّ أي dependency.
### Recommendation: (ب) الآن لأنه فوري وآمن ولا يمسّ dependencies، و (أ) لاحقاً إن أردت تسجيل الـ screenshots على Windows. العيب: على جهازك لن تتحقّق screenshots محلياً، بل على CI أو Linux فقط.
### How to answer: أضِف سطراً `### Decision (Fady): ...` تحت هذا العنوان، والروتين التالي سينفّذه.
### Decision (Fady): (أ) — 2026-10-22. ✅ Executed the same day (see the R1-tests session at the top).

## Needs Decision: 2026-10-19 — Phase C closure (C1 Hilt + C3 UI-side wiring)
### Question: كيف نُغلق Phase C لإصدار 1.0؟ البيانات (DAO + Repository) أصبحت reactive منذ 2026-05-05، لكن **لا توجد أي شاشة تراقب هذه LiveData** — كل الشاشات (MyPlantsFragment, PlantsInRoomActivity, AllPlantsFragment, TodayFragment, PlantDetailDialogFragment) لا تزال تعتمد على `DataChangeNotifier` + `getXxxBlocking()`، و Hilt = 0.
### Options:
  (أ) **تأجيل C1 (Hilt) و C3-UI إلى 1.1** — اعتبار Phase C مكتملة لـ1.0 بـ waiver صريح، وتشغيل `/phase-gate C` ثم الانتقال إلى Phase D.
  (ب) **تنفيذ C3-UI الآن بلا Hilt** — شاشة واحدة لكل تشغيل روتين (البداية: PlantsInRoomActivity → MyPlantsFragment → AllPlantsFragment → TodayFragment)، مع إبقاء `DataChangeNotifier` لأحداث rename/delete الغرف و CoverCloudSync. كل شاشة تحتاج QA مرئياً منك (خصوصاً undo-delete في PlantAdapter الذي يخفي الصف مؤقتاً — LiveData قد يعيد إظهاره قبل انتهاء Snackbar).
  (ج) **C1 Hilt + C3-UI معاً** — dependency جديدة (`com.google.dagger:hilt-android` + kapt/ksp plugin)، ~6h+، تغيير في App.java وكل ViewModel.
### Recommendation: (أ). السبب: معيار القبول الوحيد المتبقّي في Audit §8 C الذي يمكن قياسه بـ grep هو Hilt، والـUI الحالي يتحدّث فعلاً عبر DataChangeNotifier (مُختبَر يدوياً سابقاً). نقل الشاشات إلى LiveData يلمس منطق undo-delete وتحديث الصور ويحتاج QA مرئياً لكل شاشة، ومخاطرته أعلى من فائدته قبل النشر. Hilt = dependency جديدة بلا أثر وظيفي للمستخدم.
### How to answer: أضِف سطراً `### Decision (Fady): ...` تحت هذا العنوان، والروتين التالي سينفّذه.

## Session: 2026-05-20 (Phase F.audit — deep audit of the 4 disease-diagnosis features + bug fixes)

### Task Completed: Deep audit (multi-image / reference images / crop / enriched history) — 2 real bugs found & fixed, 1 surfaced warning fixed
### Layer: Phase F (Functional fixes)
### Method: read the full flow end-to-end — DiseaseDiagnosisActivity (all ~1500 lines), DiseaseDiagnosisViewModel, GeminiVisionService, DiseaseDiagnosisRepository, DiseaseReferenceImageRepository + 3 source clients, DiagnosisPhotosAdapter, DiseaseCandidateAdapter, ReferenceImageAdapter, DiagnosisHistoryAdapter, DiagnosisDetailDialog, PlantJournalAdapter, MemoirPdfBuilder, the entity, the DAO, and dialog_diagnosis_detail.xml.

### BUG 1 (real, fixed) — Gemini care hint silently dropped in 3 surfaces
**Root cause:** the diagnosis save path (`saveSelectedResult`/`saveTopResult` → `repository.save`) NEVER sets `note` — it's a reserved free-text user field, and the Gemini one-sentence hint is stored in `suggestedTreatment` (per the Feature-4 note/advice split). But three display sites still read `diagnosis.note` (which is therefore always blank):
  - `DiagnosisDetailDialog.kt` "Hinweis" line → always showed "Keine spezifischen Hinweise verfügbar."
  - `DiagnosisDetailDialog.shareDiagnosis` → shared text always said "no advice".
  - `MemoirPdfBuilder.kt` diagnosis entry → PDF never printed the hint.
**Verification:** `grep "saveSelectedResult\|saveTopResult"` → every disease-screen save call omits `note`; the only `updateUserFields` caller (the detail dialog) passes `note = diagnosis.note` unchanged → `note` is provably always blank for diagnoses.
**Fix:** fall back `note ?: suggestedTreatment ?: no_advice` at all three sites. In the detail dialog the now-redundant "Empfohlene Behandlung" row is shown ONLY when a distinct user `note` exists (otherwise the "Hinweis" line already shows the hint — no duplication).

### BUG 2 (real, fixed) — multi-image: removing photos left a stale/broken big preview
**Root cause:** the large `imagePreview` is only ever set by `runPrepareAndApply` (camera/gallery add). The strip's "×" remove path (`removeImagePath`) updates the ViewModel list but nothing re-syncs the big preview.
  - Remove ALL photos → the deleted image stayed on screen, placeholder never restored (screen looked broken).
  - Remove the primary (or any) photo → big preview kept showing a stale/deleted image.
**Fix:** the `selectedImagePaths` observer now tracks `lastDiagnosisPhotoCount`; on a REMOVAL it resyncs `showImagePreview(primary)`, and on emptying it clears the preview + restores the placeholder. APPEND is left untouched (preview already set by `runPrepareAndApply`), so no flicker / no behaviour change on capture.

### Build-surfaced warning (fixed) — `MemoirPdfBuilder.kt:203`
Editing MemoirPdfBuilder recompiled it and surfaced a pre-existing Kotlin warning `Variable 'row' initializer is redundant`. Per CLAUDE.md §3 (no warning increase), fixed by scoping `row` into the loop as a `val` (it was only ever assigned-then-read inside `forEachIndexed`).

### Files changed (3):
- `ui/disease/DiagnosisDetailDialog.kt` — advice fallback + share fallback + suggested-treatment dedup
- `feature/memoir/MemoirPdfBuilder.kt` — diagnosis-entry advice fallback + `row` val-scoping
- `ui/disease/DiseaseDiagnosisActivity.kt` — `lastDiagnosisPhotoCount` + remove/empty preview resync in the `selectedImagePaths` observer

### Verified GOOD (no bug) during the audit:
- Multi-image send: `GeminiVisionService` encodes EVERY file into its own `inlineData` part + multi-image steering prompt (`grep` confirmed `encodedImages.forEach { parts.add(... inlineData ...) }`).
- Reference-image threading: all 3 source clients (`PlantVillageCdnSource`, `WikimediaCommonsClient`, `INaturalistClient`) wrap network in `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` — no NetworkOnMainThreadException despite `fetch()` being called from `viewModelScope` (Main).
- `NO_REFERENCE_KEYS` in `DiseaseCandidateAdapter` and `DiseaseReferenceImageRepository` are in sync (healthy / unclear / physiological_stress).
- Race guards on `btnSave` / `btnTreatmentPlan` / "Keine passt" are present and correct.
- `referenceImages` LiveData read-modify-write uses `Dispatchers.Main.immediate` + `setValue` (not postValue) — avoids the 3-way fetch race dropping entries.

## Session: 2026-05-20 (Phase F.crop — close the in-activity crop gap in DiseaseDiagnosisActivity)

### Task Completed: #3 (Crop قبل الفحص) — wire ImagePostCaptureBottomSheet + UCrop into the disease screen's OWN camera/gallery buttons
### Layer: Phase F (Functional fixes)
### Context: A verification pass found #3 (crop-before-diagnosis) was only PARTIAL: crop ran only on the UnifiedCameraActivity entry path (center FAB → MODE_DIAGNOSE → UCrop → routeToTarget → EXTRA_PRELOADED_IMAGE_PATH). The disease screen's own `btnCamera`/`btnGallery` used `TakePicture()`/`GetContent()` directly with NO crop, so the 2nd–4th multi-image photos (always added via those in-screen buttons) could never be cropped. This run closes that gap by reusing the existing `ImagePostCaptureBottomSheet` + `UCrop` flow (no new components).

### Files changed (1):
- `ui/disease/DiseaseDiagnosisActivity.kt`:
  - imports: `ImagePostCaptureBottomSheet`, `UnifiedCameraActivity`, `com.yalantis.ucrop.UCrop`, `java.io.FileOutputStream`
  - new fields: `uCropLauncher` (StartActivityForResult), `pendingCropSourceFile`
  - `setupLaunchers()`: register `uCropLauncher` + `setFragmentResultListener(ImagePostCaptureBottomSheet.REQUEST_KEY)` → CROP/SKIP/CANCEL dispatch
  - camera success branch: `runPrepareAndApply(...)` → `showPostCaptureSheet(captured)`
  - `handleGalleryResult`: now copies the `content://` pick to a `DISEASE_*.jpg` temp (`copyUriToTempFile`) then shows the sheet (UCrop needs a `file://` source)
  - new methods: `copyUriToTempFile`, `showPostCaptureSheet`, `launchUCrop`, `handleCropResult`

### Why this also fixes multi-image crop (no extra code):
`runPrepareAndApply` already APPENDS to the ViewModel's image list when one is present (`addImagePath`, capped at `MAX_IMAGES=4`). Routing every in-screen camera/gallery capture through the sheet→crop→prepare pipeline means photos 2–4 get the same crop offer automatically.

### Cleanup correctness:
- SKIP: `runPrepareAndApply(temp, rawCaptureToDelete = temp)` — prepare writes a fresh `DISEASE_*.jpg`, the temp is deleted.
- CROP→OK: original source deleted, cropped (`cropped_DISEASE_*.jpg`) passed as `rawCaptureToDelete` so it's deleted after prepare. (The `cropped_` prefix is NOT caught by the 30-day `DISEASE_`-prefix pruner, but it's deleted immediately by `runPrepareAndApply`, so no leak.)
- CROP→error: falls back to the un-cropped source (analyse rather than force a retake).
- CANCEL / UCrop back: temp deleted, no orphan.
- Preloaded path (EXTRA_PRELOADED_IMAGE_PATH from UnifiedCamera) is unchanged — it's already cropped, so it still calls `runPrepareAndApply` directly and does NOT re-show the sheet.

## Session: 2026-05-18 (DEF-6 — surface configurable notification times on primary Settings tab)

### Task Completed: DEF-6. Surfaced the morning + evening notification-time pickers on the primary Einstellungen tab. The Worker + prefs + legacy Java picker already existed; the new Kotlin Settings tab was the missing surface.

### Discovery
Pre-implementation scan showed DEF-6 was already 75 % done:
  - ✅ `PlantReminderWorker.java:62-63` reads `notif_morning_hour` / `notif_evening_hour` from the shared `"prefs"` SharedPreferences with defaults 7 + 17, clamped at 5-12 / 14-22.
  - ✅ `SettingsDialogFragment.java:452-501` had the `TimePickerDialog` UI wired correctly.
  - ❌ But `SettingsDialogFragment` is only reachable from the legacy "Erweiterte Einstellungen" sub-dialog (MainActivity:720 + SettingsFragment.kt:440). The primary Settings tab — what bottom-nav users see — never exposed the pickers. Most users would never find them.

### What shipped

**`app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_settings.xml`** — new 3b "Notifications" section inserted between section 3 (Personalization → Language) and section 4 (Subscription). Two stacked rows:
  - `rowNotifMorning` → label "Morgens erinnern", subtitle shows current hour as "07:00 Uhr".
  - `rowNotifEvening` → label "Abends erinnern", subtitle shows current hour as "17:00 Uhr".
  Both use the existing `@style/SettingsRow` + `@drawable/ic_notification_plant`.

**`app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/ui/settings/SettingsFragment.kt`** — added 3 functions:
  - `bindNotifTimeRows(root)` — reads current prefs, populates value labels, wires click → `showNotifTimePicker`.
  - `showNotifTimePicker(isMorning, onSaved)` — opens `android.app.TimePickerDialog` with 24-hour layout. Save path clamps to safe band (5-12 morning, 14-22 evening) so the two 4-hour windows never overlap or wrap past midnight — same clamps the Worker applies as defence in depth.
  - `Quad` private data class for the (key, default, minH, maxH) tuple (Kotlin's stdlib only ships `Triple`).
  Existing `bindAppearanceSection` calls `bindNotifTimeRows(root)` after the language picker wiring.

### Strings used
All 7 DE + EN strings already shipped previously: `settings_section_notifications`, `settings_notif_morning_label`, `settings_notif_evening_label`, `settings_notif_morning_hint`, `settings_notif_evening_hint`, `settings_notif_time_format`. No new strings added.

### Why this matters
Pre-fix: a night-shift user got watering notifications at 7 AM (woken up) and 5 PM (sleeping). They had to find "Erweiterte Einstellungen → Benachrichtigungen" to fix it — a path most users never explore. Post-fix: the primary Settings tab exposes it directly with sensible defaults and clamps that prevent broken windows.

## Session: 2026-05-18 (Audit pass 3 — billing + auth files, found 2 bugs in BillingManager)

### Task Completed: same audit method as passes 1+2 on BillingManager.kt + 3 auth files (AuthRepository.kt, LoginDialogFragment.java, AuthStartDialogFragment.java). Found 2 bugs in BillingManager (one production-blocking hang, one UX black hole). The 3 auth files all clean.

### Results

| File | Lines | Findings |
|------|-------|----------|
| `BillingManager.kt` | 465 | 🔴 **2 bugs found and fixed** (B1 + B4 below) |
| `AuthRepository.kt` | 198 | ✅ **Clean.** Double-checked locking on singleton, applicationContext only, SharedPreferences cached at construction, all exceptions logged via CrashReporter. |
| `LoginDialogFragment.java` | 510 | ✅ **Clean.** All 3 Firebase `addOnCompleteListener` callbacks have `isAdded()` guards (L300, L379, L406). Forgot-password flow guarded (today's UI-BUG-4 fix preserved). |
| `AuthStartDialogFragment.java` | 523 | ✅ **Clean.** All 3 Google sign-in `addOn*Listener` callbacks have `isAdded()` guards (L316, L333, L425). `onSignedIn` itself guards at L444. |

### 🔴 Bug B1 — `connect()` can hang forever if Play Store service drops mid-handshake
**Location:** `BillingManager.kt:78-95`.

**What was wrong:** `suspendCoroutine { cont -> billingClient.startConnection(...) }`. Two failure modes:
  1. If `onBillingSetupFinished` fired twice (SDK auto-reconnect mid-setup), `cont.resume(ok)` threw `IllegalStateException: Already resumed`.
  2. If `onBillingServiceDisconnected` fired BEFORE `onBillingSetupFinished` (Play Store killed during handshake), `cont` was never resumed → the `connect()` coroutine hangs forever, blocking `BillingManager.connectAsync()` and starving every paywall subscriber of `isPro` until process restart.

**Fix:** rewrote with `suspendCancellableCoroutine` + `AtomicBoolean resumed` guard:
  - Both `onBillingSetupFinished` and `onBillingServiceDisconnected` use `resumed.compareAndSet(false, true)` before `cont.resume(...)`.
  - The disconnect path resolves `false` if setup hadn't completed → caller cleanly sees failure instead of hanging.
  - Refresh of `_isPro` from local prefs on disconnect kept as the existing side-effect.

### 🔴 Bug B4 — Purchase errors silently swallowed (esp. `ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED`)
**Location:** `BillingManager.kt:196-198` (`onPurchasesUpdated`).

**What was wrong:** The else-if only handled `USER_CANCELED`. Every other response code (`BILLING_UNAVAILABLE`, `SERVICE_DISCONNECTED`, `DEVELOPER_ERROR`, `ERROR`, `NETWORK_ERROR`, `SERVICE_TIMEOUT`, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED`, `ITEM_NOT_OWNED`, `ITEM_UNAVAILABLE`, **`ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED`**) fell through to a no-op. The most common user-visible case:
  - User re-installs the app, signs in again, tries to upgrade to Pro from inside the app → Play returns `ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED` because the user already bought it on another device or before re-install → app silently does nothing → user thinks "the purchase didn't work" → support ticket.

**Fix:** Added two new branches:
  - `ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED` → `refreshPurchases()` to pull the existing entitlement and re-grant Pro via the verified path. The user sees Pro activate within seconds.
  - Any other code → `CrashReporter.log` with the responseCode + debugMessage so we can see distribution in Crashlytics and decide which deserve user-facing toasts in a 1.1 follow-up.

### Evidence
```
$ ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 12s
( 0 new Kotlin warnings )

$ ./gradlew :app:bundleProdRelease
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 3m
58 actionable tasks: 20 executed, 38 up-to-date

$ ls -lh app/build/outputs/bundle/prodRelease/app-prod-release.aab
-rw-r--r-- 16M  app-prod-release.aab    (unchanged after both fixes)

$ grep -n "AtomicBoolean\|suspendCancellableCoroutine\|ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED\|resumed.compareAndSet" \
   app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/billing/BillingManager.kt
9:  import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
13: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
98: suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
99: val resumed = AtomicBoolean(false)
103: if (resumed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
116: if (resumed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
207: } else if (result.responseCode == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED) {
```

### Acceptance checklist
  - [✅] BillingManager.connect uses suspendCancellableCoroutine + AtomicBoolean guard.
  - [✅] onPurchasesUpdated handles ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED via refreshPurchases.
  - [✅] All other response codes logged to CrashReporter with code + debugMessage.
  - [✅] AuthRepository / LoginDialogFragment / AuthStartDialogFragment: no findings, no edits.
  - [✅] `assembleDebug` BUILD SUCCESSFUL (12s), 0 new warnings.
  - [✅] `bundleProdRelease` BUILD SUCCESSFUL (3m), AAB still 16 MB.

### Build Status: ✅ both builds pass.

### Regressions: None. Both fixes are defensive — B1 widens connect()'s exit paths, B4 adds handling for previously-silent codes.

  - **Pass 2** (untouched files): 2 (pending-delete recovery missed 7 cloud subcollections + disease-chooser `.show()` race).

## Session: 2026-05-18 (Audit pass 2 — 3 untouched-today files, found 2 bugs in MainActivity)

### Task Completed: same audit rigor as pass 1 but on files NOT touched in today's edits. Scope: `PlantNotificationHelper.java`, `MainActivity.java`, `FirebaseSyncManager.java`. Found 2 critical pre-existing bugs in MainActivity; other 2 files clean. prodRelease AAB rebuilt at 16 MB.

### Why pass 2 ran
Pass 1 only audited what I edited today. Critical files I didn't touch (because earlier sessions did) could still carry pre-existing bugs that today's changes might expose. Same audit method = same chance of catching them.

### Results

| File | Lines | Findings |
|------|-------|----------|
| `PlantNotificationHelper.java` | 269 | ✅ **Clean.** All 7 user-facing strings go through `R.string.*`. 1 `getStringArray` uses resource. No hardcoded DE leakage. |
| `FirebaseSyncManager.java` | 1084 | ✅ **Clean.** 25/25 `getCurrentUid()` call sites guard against null (24 immediate early-return + 1 inline). Shared mutable state (`pending` map) is `ConcurrentHashMap`. No persistent listeners that could leak. |
| `MainActivity.java` | 1685 | 🔴 **2 bugs found and fixed.** Details below. |

### 🔴 Bug A — Pending-delete recovery uses incomplete cloud cascade (GDPR risk)
**Location:** `MainActivity.java:170-183` (the `pending_delete_email` recovery flow that runs in `onCreate` when a previous delete attempt was interrupted by re-auth failure).

**What was wrong:** The recovery path called `FirebaseSyncManager.get().deleteAllPhotosForUser(em)` — the legacy single-collection method — then dropped local rows and finally called `fbU.delete()`. This left the other SEVEN per-user cloud subcollections (plants / reminders / rooms / memos / vacation / streak / challenges / proStatus) as GDPR orphans on Firebase. Same pre-fix shape as DEF-2 in the SettingsDialogFragment delete path, which had been correctly cascaded → but the recovery path was a copy-paste that didn't get the fix.

**Fix:** rewrote the recovery sequence to mirror `SettingsDialogFragment.performFirebaseDelete`:
  1. `FirebaseSyncManager.get().deleteAllForUser(callback)` — full 11-collection cloud cascade awaited.
  2. Local DB cleanup (4 repositories) on BgExecutor.io.
  3. `fbU.delete()` on main thread, guarded by `isFinishing() || isDestroyed()` before the call.
  4. Cascade callback's `cascadeOk=false` logged but auth delete proceeds anyway (matches the SettingsDialogFragment fallback policy — half-deleted is still a DSGVO improvement over fully-orphaned).

### 🔴 Bug B — Disease-chooser `.show()` in async callback without `isStateSaved` guard
**Location:** `MainActivity.java:505-508` (`pickPlantThenLaunchDisease`).

**What was wrong:** `runOnUiThread { ... ActionListDialogFragment.show(getSupportFragmentManager(), ...) }` only checked `isFinishing() || isDestroyed()`. Between `onSaveInstanceState` and `onResume` an Activity is NOT destroyed and NOT finishing, but `FragmentManager.commit()` (which `.show()` calls) throws `IllegalStateException: Can not perform this action after onSaveInstanceState`. Same root cause as DEF-22's paywall fix, in a different surface.

**Fix:** added `if (getSupportFragmentManager().isStateSaved()) return;` immediately before the `.show()` call. The Toast at the empty-list branch above stays unguarded since `Toast` is safe to fire at any lifecycle state.

### Evidence
```
$ ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 17s

$ ./gradlew :app:bundleProdRelease
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 2m 57s
58 actionable tasks: 20 executed, 38 up-to-date

$ ls -lh app/build/outputs/bundle/prodRelease/app-prod-release.aab
-rw-r--r-- 16M  app-prod-release.aab    (unchanged size after both fixes)

$ grep -c "deleteAllForUser\|isStateSaved" app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/MainActivity.java
2    (= 1 cascade call in pending-delete recovery + 1 isStateSaved guard before show)
```

### Acceptance checklist
  - [✅] PlantNotificationHelper: 0 hardcoded DE strings (sample-verified via grep on string literals > 6 chars excluding constants/log tags).
  - [✅] FirebaseSyncManager: 25/25 null-uid guards, ConcurrentHashMap for shared state, 0 leak-prone listeners.
  - [✅] MainActivity Bug A: pending-delete recovery now uses full 11-collection cascade.
  - [✅] MainActivity Bug B: isStateSaved guard before disease-chooser show().
  - [✅] `assembleDebug` + `bundleProdRelease` both pass.
  - [✅] AAB size unchanged at 16 MB.

### Build Status: ✅ both builds pass.

### Regressions: None — both fixes are defensive additions (Bug A widens cleanup scope, Bug B adds a guard). No happy-path behaviour changed.

### Cumulative bug-catch count from today's audits (passes 1 + 2)
**7 critical bugs caught BEFORE ship:**
  - **Pass 1 (today's edits):** locale forced DE every cold start (App.java) + locale hardcoded per Activity wrap (FontScaleHelper.kt) + Kotlin language picker missing recreate() + Java language picker missing recreate() + 5 room colours failed AA contrast → fixed.
  - **Pass 2 (untouched files):** pending-delete recovery missed 7 cloud subcollections (GDPR) + disease-chooser `.show()` race → fixed.

Net effect: had the AAB shipped without these audits, B4 picker would have been read-only, 5 room icons would have been invisible (white-on-low-contrast), GDPR orphans would persist in Firebase for any user who hit a delete re-auth retry, and the disease chooser would crash on a fraction of users who backgrounded the app mid-query.

## Session: 2026-05-18 (Post-implementation audit — 5 critical bugs caught + fixed)

### Task Completed: full review of every edit shipped 2026-05-17→18. Caught **5 critical bugs** that would have made today's biggest features (B4 language picker, B3 bilingual catalog, UI-BUG-8 room palette) effectively dead in production. All 5 fixed in this session; prodRelease AAB rebuilt at 16 MB.

### Why this audit ran
Fady asked for a final review before ship: "هل هناك ثغرات او مشاكل متبقية؟" Systematic re-read of every edit + cross-cutting greps for known pitfalls (locale overrides, AA contrast, dialog state-saved guards, dead callers, CSV quoting).

### 🔴 Bug 1 — `App.java:119` `applyAppLocale()` forced German on every cold start
**Severity:** showstopper for Phase B4.
The previous policy was "PlantCare is DE-only — force every launch to German via `AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales(forLanguageTags("de"))`." After Phase B4 shipped a user-facing language picker, this override silently undid the user's choice on every process start. Picker said "English", user closed app, opened again, German.
**Fix:** guard with `if (!getApplicationLocales().isEmpty()) return;`. Default to DE only when no user choice exists. Big multi-paragraph comment in the file documents the behaviour change.

### 🔴 Bug 2 — `FontScaleHelper.kt:46` hard-coded `Locale("de")` for every Activity wrap
**Severity:** showstopper, compounding bug 1.
`FontScaleHelper.wrap()` is called from `attachBaseContext` of every Activity. It was pinning the Configuration's locale to German regardless of `AppCompatDelegate` state — so even within a single session, the picker's "English" choice would be reset to German the moment any Activity was rebuilt.
**Fix:** read `AppCompatDelegate.getApplicationLocales()` first; if non-empty pick that locale (collapsed to `de` / `en` 2-letter primary), else fall back to GERMAN default. Comment block documents the audit fix.

### 🔴 Bug 3 — `SettingsFragment.kt:218` language picker did not `recreate()` Activity
**Severity:** UX-killing for B4.
The `onPicked` callback only refreshed the row's value-text. The user saw "English" appear in the label, but the rest of the screen kept rendering German strings until they killed and relaunched the app. The sibling theme picker at line 170 had been calling `recreate()` for exactly this reason — language picker forgot to.
**Fix:** add `requireActivity().recreate()` inside the `onPicked` lambda, same pattern as theme.

### 🔴 Bug 4 — `SettingsDialogFragment.java:666` legacy Java picker also missing `recreate()`
**Severity:** same as Bug 3, in the legacy dialog reachable from MainActivity:719 and as "Erweiterte Einstellungen" sub-dialog (SettingsFragment.kt:440).
**Fix:** add `requireActivity().recreate()` inside the `setOnCheckedChangeListener` after `setApplicationLocales`, wrapped in try/catch + `isAdded()` guard since this is a DialogFragment that may be detached when the callback fires.

### 🔴 Bug 5 — 5 of 12 UI-BUG-8 room colours failed WCAG AA 3:1 contrast with white foreground
**Severity:** accessibility + visual readability — white icon glyphs were near-invisible on the worst offenders.
| Token | Before | Contrast | After | Contrast |
|-------|--------|----------|-------|----------|
| `room_kitchen` | `#F2A93B` | **2.00** ❌ | `#C97614` | **3.45** ✅ |
| `room_balcony` | `#6FB76C` | 2.42 ❌ | `#4F9C4D` | 3.39 ✅ |
| `room_bathroom` | `#4FB3BF` | 2.46 ❌ | `#2A92A0` | 3.67 ✅ |
| `room_hallway` | `#B9925D` | 2.86 ❌ | `#9C7A45` | 3.97 ✅ |
| `room_kids` | `#E8729E` | 2.86 ❌ | `#C9527E` | 4.21 ✅ |

The other 7 already passed (room_living 3.00, room_garden 3.02 borderline; the rest > 3.3). Dark-mode siblings all pass against the `#2A2D32` sage card background (4.19 – 5.44 range).

### ✅ False-alarm checks (verified working as designed)
  - **CSV comma quoting** — 2 EN translations contain commas (`"Permeable, rather lean soil."` + `"Coarse bark, or in a basket without soil."`). Python's `QUOTE_MINIMAL` writer properly wrapped both with double quotes; Kotlin's `parseCsvLine` correctly returns 12 cells for those rows (confirmed by mirroring the parser in Python against every match).
  - **0 empty care-text cells** across all 505 × 4 = 2020 care cells.

## Session: 2026-05-18 (DEF-10 dead code removal + DEF-17a listener thread safety)

### Tasks Completed: DEF-10 (deleted dead recordPlantCountForChallenge) + DEF-17a (HashSet → CopyOnWriteArraySet).

### DEF-10 — Dead function removed
**File:** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/ui/viewmodel/TodayViewModel.kt`
`recordPlantCountForChallenge(email, count)` at L215-220 had zero callers anywhere in the codebase (verified by repo-wide grep — only its own declaration + an unrelated explanatory comment at L168 matched). Modern code path goes through `ChallengeRegistry.updateProgress` directly inside the refresh loop. Removed the function; the L168 comment about the old direct-call pattern stays as it explains the *current* path's evolution.

### DEF-17a — Listener set thread safety
**File:** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/DataChangeNotifier.java`
`listeners` was `HashSet<Runnable>`. The `notifyChange` snapshot copy (`new ArrayList<>(listeners)`) uses HashSet's fail-fast iterator → if `addListener` / `removeListener` fires from a background worker during the snapshot, the copy throws `ConcurrentModificationException`. Switched to `CopyOnWriteArraySet<Runnable>`:
  - `add` / `remove` / iteration are all thread-safe.
  - Per-write array copy is O(n) but n is typically 1-3 (Fragment + Worker + Widget) → cost is noise.
  - `notifyChange`'s explicit snapshot copy could now be removed, but it stays as a defence in depth.

### Evidence

```
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 14s
87 actionable tasks: 13 executed, 74 up-to-date

$ grep -rn "recordPlantCountForChallenge" app/src

( declaration deleted )

$ grep -n "HashSet\|CopyOnWriteArraySet" app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/DataChangeNotifier.java

22: private static final Set<Runnable> listeners = new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
( import java.util.HashSet removed )
```

### Acceptance checklist

  - [✅] DEF-10: function declaration deleted, no compile errors → confirms zero callers.
  - [✅] DEF-17a: `CopyOnWriteArraySet` is thread-safe for concurrent add/remove + iteration.
  - [✅] `java.util.HashSet` import removed from `DataChangeNotifier`.

## Session: 2026-05-18 (DEF-22 + DEF-21 stability fixes; DEF-18 confirmed already resolved)

### Tasks Completed: DEF-22 (paywall isStateSaved guard) + DEF-21 (recycle camera bitmap after downscale). DEF-18 confirmed already fixed by an earlier round; entry in DEFERRED_ISSUES.md is stale.

### Layer: Phase C-adjacent hardening — defensive cleanup before release.

### DEF-22 — Paywall show() crash on backgrounding
**File:** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/AddToMyPlantsDialogFragment.java`
The PaywallDialogFragment.show() at the Pro-limit branch fires from a
FragmentBg callback. If the user backgrounds the app *during* the
plant-count query, `isAdded()` is true but state is saved → `show()`
throws "Can not perform this action after onSaveInstanceState".
Added `if (isStateSaved()) return;` short-circuit before show().

### DEF-21 — Camera bitmap pinned in ImageView until dialog close
**File:** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/AddCustomPlantDialogFragment.java`
Previously `takePicturePreview` + `pickImage` both did
`imagePath = saveBitmap(bitmap); showPreview(bitmap)` — passing the
original 4000×3000 ARGB_8888 bitmap (~48 MB) into the ImageView, which
held it until the dialog closed.

Refactored `saveBitmap` into `persistAndPreview` that:
  1. Downscales to 1280px long edge.
  2. Writes the downscaled JPEG to disk.
  3. Hands the **downscaled** copy to `showPreview` (so the heavy
     original is no longer pinned by the ImageView).
  4. Recycles the original bitmap.
  5. On exception, best-effort recycles the downscaled bitmap to keep
     the heap clean even on the unhappy path.

Both call sites collapsed from 2 lines to 1: `persistAndPreview(bmp)`.

### DEF-18 — Already resolved (housekeeping)
`PlantImageLoader.kt:39` uses a single shared `ROOT_SCOPE` with a
`SupervisorJob`, tags the per-bind `Job` on the ImageView via
`R.id.tag_plant_image_load_job` (declared in ids.xml:10), and cancels
the prior job before starting a new one (line 59). The original
"`CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Main).launch` per call" anti-pattern is
already gone. DEFERRED_ISSUES.md entry is stale; safe to delete in a
follow-up housekeeping pass.

### Evidence
```

BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 14s
87 actionable tasks: 10 executed, 77 up-to-date

$ grep -n 'isStateSaved' app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/AddToMyPlantsDialogFragment.java
391:  if (isStateSaved()) return;

$ grep -n 'persistAndPreview\|saveBitmap' app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/AddCustomPlantDialogFragment.java
44:  persistAndPreview(bitmap);          (was: saveBitmap + showPreview)
58:  persistAndPreview(bmp);
193: private void persistAndPreview(Bitmap original) {
(no remaining references to saveBitmap — fully replaced)

$ grep -n 'ROOT_SCOPE\|LOAD_JOB_TAG_KEY' app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/weekbar/PlantImageLoader.kt
```

## Session: 2026-05-18 (Phase B3 — plants.csv bilingual + locale-aware seeder + B4 dialog theme fix)

### Tasks Completed: B3 (505 rows × 4 care fields English-translated, CSV widened to 12 columns, CatalogSeeder reads the locale-matching column) + B4 hotfix (compile error from previous round).

### Layer: Phase B (i18n) — closes the last DE-only content surface in the app.

### Discovery before translation
Profiled `app/src/main/assets/plants.csv` (505 rows): the four care-text columns held **448 unique values** combined, not 2020 (lighting 115 + soil 171 + fertilizing 101 + watering 61). The top 5 lighting values alone cover 47 % of rows. Manual translation of the unique set was the right shape of work; brute-forcing per-row was wasted effort.

### What shipped

**1. `app/src/main/assets/plants.csv` — schema extended 8 → 12 columns**
  - New columns interleaved next to their German siblings: `lighting | lightingEn | soil | soilEn | fertilizing | fertilizingEn | watering | wateringEn`.
  - All 505 × 4 cells populated from a hand-curated EN dictionary (built/_translations_en.json, 448 unique entries).
  - File grew 85 KB → 164 KB — matches the Audit's prediction (~140 KB).
  - Translation style: technical horticultural English (British spelling for "fertilise" / "watering" — matches British plant-care convention; matches the app's German "düngen / gießen" register).
  - Example row (Aloe Vera):
    ```
    lighting     Helles bis mittleres Licht. Direkte Sonne fördert das Wachstum.
    lightingEn   Bright to medium light. Direct sun promotes growth.
    soil         Gut drainierende Kakteenerde. Kein schwerer Lehm.
    soilEn       Well-draining cactus soil. No heavy loam.
    fertilizing  Von Frühling bis Sommer alle 4 Wochen düngen. Im Winter nicht düngen.
    fertilizingEn Fertilise every 4 weeks from spring through summer. No fertilising in winter.
    watering     Alle 14 Tage. Wenig Wasser genügt.
    wateringEn   Every 14 days. Little water suffices.
    ```

**2. `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/data/CatalogSeeder.kt` — locale-aware reader**
  - Added 4 nullable EN column indices to `ColumnIndex` (`lightingEn`/`soilEn`/`fertilizingEn`/`wateringEn`).
  - New helper `isAppLocaleEnglish()` checks `AppCompatDelegate.getApplicationLocales()` first (respects the B4 per-app picker) and falls back to `Locale.getDefault().language`.
  - Seed loop now uses a local `pick(deIdx, enIdx)` lambda — when running in English AND the EN cell is present and non-blank, the EN value is stored; otherwise falls back to DE. Robust against rows that don't have EN backfilled (won't be the case for the shipped CSV, but the seeder stays safe).
  - No Room schema migration needed — the `Plant.lighting/soil/fertilizing/watering` fields keep their existing nullable-String shape and now just hold the locale-appropriate text.

**3. `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/ui/settings/SettingsFragment.kt` — B4 compile-error hotfix**
  - Previous round wrote `android.app.Dialog(requireContext(), theme)` — `theme` is a `DialogFragment` property and `SettingsFragment` is a plain `Fragment`. Build broke with `e: Unresolved reference: theme`.
  - Replaced with the default `android.app.Dialog(requireContext())` constructor. Window background is already overridden to `android.R.color.transparent` so the inner `MaterialCardView` shapes the surface unchanged.

### Known limitation (documented for v1.0)
The catalog table is seeded **once** on first launch (`countAllBlocking() == 0` guard). If the user installs the app while the device locale is German, then later switches to English via the B4 picker, the catalog text **stays German** until they Clear Data. The app UI / strings / paywall / forgot-password all switch correctly; only the 505 catalog plants don't. Out-of-scope for this round; v1.1 can add a reseed-on-locale-change hook if telemetry shows users hit this.

## Session: 2026-05-17 (Phase B4 — language picker brand-match)

### Task Completed: B4 — language picker dialog refactored from plain `AlertDialog.Builder.setSingleChoiceItems` to a custom branded dialog matching the rest of the auth/forgot-password identity.

### Layer: Phase B (i18n) — closes the per-app language picker UI gap surfaced by the Audit and aligns it with the visual-identity standard that UI-BUG-4 established.

### Why the existing implementation wasn't enough
Scan showed `SettingsFragment.kt:232 showLanguagePicker()` was already wired correctly (System / DE / EN → `AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales`). The Audit estimate of ~2h was based on assuming the picker needed to be built from scratch. Actual gap: the picker used a bare AlertDialog — exactly the off-brand look that UI-BUG-4 rejected in the forgot-password dialog earlier today. Same quality bar = same fix.

### Changes shipped

**New layout `app/src/main/res/layout/dialog_language_picker.xml`:**
  - `MaterialCardView` wrapper, 20dp corners, 3dp elevation (same as `dialog_forgot_password.xml` and `dialog_login.xml`).
  - Title row: `textLanguageTitle` (Inter Headline 20sp, reading `@string/settings_row_language`) + top-right close button.
  - `RadioGroup` with 3 vertical rows: System / Deutsch / English. `buttonTint="@color/pc_primary"` so the selected radio uses the vivid green.
  - Outlined "Abbrechen" button row (end-aligned).

**`SettingsFragment.kt` refactor:**
  - `showLanguagePicker(...)` now inflates `dialog_language_picker.xml` instead of building an AlertDialog.
  - Reads current locale via `AppCompatDelegate.getApplicationLocales().toLanguageTags()` and pre-checks the matching radio.
  - `RadioGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener` applies the locale change immediately and dismisses — preserves the original single-choice UX.
  - Close button + Cancel button both call `dialog.dismiss()`.
  - `AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales(...)` callback unchanged → the underlying locale switch behaviour is identical.

## Session: 2026-05-17 (UI-BUG-7 round 2 — kill the floating FAB, stack inline)

### Task Completed: UI-BUG-7 round 2 — properly resolved the "Pflanze hinzufügen overlaps Toilette" defect that round 1 (padding+elevation+font) only cosmetically improved.

### Layer: Phase G post-close — emulator screenshot 5 (23:22) confirmed round 1 didn't move the actual FAB position.

### Why round 1 was insufficient
The round-1 edit added `paddingBottom="88dp"` + `clipToPadding="false"` to `recyclerViewRooms` plus dropped FAB elevation 6dp→3dp and added Inter SemiBold typography. That changed the *scroll boundary* (Toilette could scroll past where the FAB sits) and softened the FAB tone — but the FAB was still constraint-anchored absolutely above btnAddRoom at the end edge, so at first-render it visibly floated over the Toilette card. The user-visible bug was unchanged.

### Round 2 fix shipped
**`app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_my_plants.xml`:**
  - Removed `ExtendedFloatingActionButton` entirely.
  - Added `MaterialButton` with style `@style/PlantCare.Button.Filled`, `id="@+id/fabAddPlant"` (same id — no Java change), `layout_width="0dp"` full-width, constrained `Start/End → parent`, `Bottom → btnAddRoom.top`.
  - `recyclerViewRooms.layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf` re-pointed `btnAddRoom → fabAddPlant`. RecyclerView paddingBottom restored 88dp → 16dp (no floating element to clear).
  - New stack hierarchy: rooms list ↑ primary green "Pflanze hinzufügen" ↑ tonal "Zimmer hinzufügen" ↑ screen bottom.

### Why this works
- `MaterialButton` is a regular widget, not a FloatingActionButton — has no implicit z-translation or scroll-elevation animation, so it cannot float over content.
- `MyPlantsFragment.java:113` reads `View fabAddPlant = root.findViewById(R.id.fabAddPlant)` then calls `setOnClickListener` — works on any View. Type swap is invisible to Java.
- Both buttons stacked full-width give clear visual hierarchy (primary > secondary) and zero overlap regardless of how many rooms the user has.


## Session: 2026-05-17 (G-CRITICAL-1 — Compose typography was wired to Roboto, not Inter / Manrope)

### Task Completed: G-CRITICAL-1 — `ui/theme/Type.kt` was using `FontFamily.SansSerif` (= Android default Roboto) for h5/body1/caption and Material defaults (also Roboto) for every other style. The entire Compose layer (Home / WeekBar / RemindersList / CalendarPhotoGrid / MonthPicker) therefore rendered in Roboto, while the XML layer rendered in Manrope ExtraBold + Inter. Two different typefaces in one app. Now: Compose pulls the same two families from `res/font/` that the XML themes.xml uses, with a fully-expanded Typography mapping every MaterialTheme slot to an explicit Inter weight (Manrope reserved for h5 hero).

### Layer: Phase G post-close — the real fix that the earlier "G-typography-fix" round (XML themes only) couldn't deliver.

### Why the earlier rounds didn't fix Fady's "everything looks chunky" feedback
The G-typography-fix entry below moved `TextAppearance.PlantCare.Title` from Manrope to Inter SemiBold in `values/themes.xml`. That correctly fixed every TextView using a MaterialComponents textAppearance — Konto erstellen / Anmelden / dialog headers / Settings list items. But the screens Fady sees first — Home, the week strip, the streak card, the reminders list — are **Compose**. Compose does not read `themes.xml` typography. It reads `MaterialTheme.typography`, which was sourced from `ui/theme/Type.kt`, which until this round pointed every slot at `FontFamily.SansSerif`. The emulator's verdict ("the numbers are ugly, the font is thick") was Roboto leaking through the entire Compose surface.

### Family mapping
  - `InterFamily` — Font(R.font.inter_regular, FontWeight.Normal) + Font(R.font.inter_semibold, FontWeight.SemiBold). Drives body, caption, button, subtitle, h6, day-strip numbers, list rows.
  - `ManropeFamily` — Font(R.font.manrope_extra_bold, FontWeight.ExtraBold). Drives h5 only — the brand-hero moment (Home's top heading).

### Typography slot table (Compose MaterialTheme M2)
  | Slot | Family | Weight | Size | Used by |
  |------|--------|--------|------|---------|
  | h5 | Manrope | ExtraBold (800) | 24sp | Top-of-screen brand headings |
  | h6 | Inter | SemiBold (600) | 20sp | Card / dialog / section titles |
  | subtitle1 | Inter | SemiBold (600) | 17sp | Subsection headers |
  | subtitle2 | Inter | SemiBold (600) | 14sp | Small-caps style |
  | body1 | Inter | Regular (400) | 15sp | Main reading text |
  | body2 | Inter | Regular (400) | 13sp | Secondary text, hint lines |
  | button | Inter | SemiBold (600) | 15sp | All MaterialButton labels |
  | caption | Inter | Regular (400) | 12sp | Time stamps, counts |
  | overline | Inter | SemiBold (600) | 11sp | All-caps eyebrows |

### Evidence
```
$ grep -E 'FontFamily|InterFamily|ManropeFamily' ui/theme/Type.kt | wc -l
17    # was 3 (all FontFamily.SansSerif)

$ grep -c 'Font(R.font.inter_regular\|Font(R.font.inter_semibold\|Font(R.font.manrope_extra_bold' ui/theme/Type.kt
3     # was 0

$ grep -c 'FontFamily.SansSerif' ui/theme/Type.kt
0     # was 3

# Type.kt brace balance
$ grep -c '(' ui/theme/Type.kt   →  28
$ grep -c ')' ui/theme/Type.kt   →  28
```

### Files changed
  - `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/ui/theme/Type.kt` — full rewrite (3 SansSerif TextStyles → 9 explicit Inter/Manrope TextStyles).

### Acceptance checklist (G-CRITICAL-1)
  - [✅] Type.kt no longer references `FontFamily.SansSerif`.
  - [✅] InterFamily declared with two weights (Regular 400, SemiBold 600) pointing at the real TTFs.
  - [✅] ManropeFamily declared with the ExtraBold TTF.
  - [✅] All 9 MaterialTheme M2 typography slots have an explicit family + weight.
  - [✅] 243/243 res XML files parse.
  - [⏳] On-device verification pending Fady's rebuild — should be the round that closes the "looks chunky" feedback loop because every Compose surface will now render in the same Inter/Manrope it always should have.

## Session: 2026-05-17 (G-typography-fix — emulator install revealed the design read as "chunky / 2014 Material 1.0")

### Task Completed: G-TYPOGRAPHY — Side-loaded the app to Fady's emulator and his immediate reaction was "everything looks unprofessional, edges too wide and thick, fonts thick, numbers ugly." Root-caused to typography (Manrope ExtraBold 800 globally) + over-generous corner radii (24-28dp on cards). Both fixed in this round.

### Layer: Phase G post-close — emulator-verification feedback loop.

### Diagnosis

The pre-built screenshots Fady sent earlier in the day *looked* aligned to the reference apps (same palette, same layout structure, same nav). The static compare missed the issue because the issue was *weight*, not *structure*. On a live screen, the weight problem was immediate.

**`@font/manrope`** was wired in G0.2 to a single TTF: **Manrope-ExtraBold (weight 800)**. Every `TextAppearance.PlantCare.Headline` and `TextAppearance.PlantCare.Title` style points at `@font/manrope` + `android:textStyle="bold"`. The 800-weight TTF was already thicker than reference apps' Bold (700), and stacking `textStyle=bold` on top either redundantly picked the same 800 variant or triggered fake-bold synthesis on certain renderers — net effect: every header in the app rendered close to Black (900). On a 360dp phone this reads as "shouty" / "2014 Material 1.0", not "premium".

**Corners**: Cards used 24dp via `PlantCare.Card`, dialog wrappers ran 28dp inline (16 surfaces), Pro banner ran 24dp. Reference Plant Identifier / Set care reminders use ~16-20dp on cards. The 4-8dp extra read as visibly "chunky" against the tight reference styling.

### Fixes shipped

**Typography (`values/themes.xml`):**
  | Style | Before | After | Why |
  |-------|--------|-------|-----|
  | `Headline` | Manrope ExtraBold (800) @ **28sp** | Manrope ExtraBold @ **24sp** (lineSpacingMultiplier 1.10 → 1.15) | Keeps the brand-hero ExtraBold moment but at a size that doesn't dominate the small viewport. |
  | `Title` | **Manrope ExtraBold** (800) @ 20sp + `textStyle=bold` | **Inter SemiBold** (600) @ 20sp + `textStyle=bold` | This is the single highest-impact change of the round. `Title` is the style every "Home" / "Mein Garten" / "Konto erstellen" / "Alle Funktionen freischalten" header uses. Switching the family alone drops perceived weight by ~25%. |
  | `Subtitle` | Inter @ 17sp + `textStyle=bold` (picked weight 600) | Inter @ 17sp **no bold** (picks weight 400) | Form labels like "E-Mail" / "Passwort" were competing with their adjacent Title. Now they read as calm supporting lines. |

**Shape system (`values/shapes.xml`):**
  | Style | Before | After |
  |-------|--------|-------|
  | `ShapeAppearance.PlantCare.Card` | 24dp | **18dp** |
  | `ShapeAppearance.PlantCare.Hero` | 28dp | **20dp** |
  | `ShapeAppearance.PlantCare.ThumbnailLarge` | 22dp | **16dp** |
  | `ShapeAppearance.PlantCare.Input` | 18dp | **14dp** |
  | `ShapeAppearance.PlantCare.Thumbnail` | 16dp | **12dp** |
  | `PlantCare.Card` style (themes.xml) | cardCornerRadius=24dp | cardCornerRadius=**18dp** |

**Inline cardCornerRadius across 22 layout files:**
  - `cardCornerRadius="28dp"` → `cardCornerRadius="20dp"` (**16 occurrences** — every dialog wrapper: `dialog_add_*`, `dialog_auth_start`, `dialog_consent`, `dialog_edit_*`, `dialog_login`, `dialog_paywall`, `dialog_reschedule`, `dialog_today_reminder_detail`, `fragment_today`).
  - `cardCornerRadius="24dp"` → `cardCornerRadius="20dp"` (**6 occurrences** — `fragment_all_plants`, `fragment_diagnose`, `fragment_today`, `include_hero_pro_banner`, `item_plant`, `item_room`).

### Evidence (grep / xmllint)
```
# Typography migration
$ grep -A 6 'TextAppearance.PlantCare.Title"' values/themes.xml | grep fontFamily
    <item name="android:fontFamily">@font/inter</item>     # was @font/manrope
    <item name="fontFamily">@font/inter</item>

$ grep 'textSize' values/themes.xml | grep Headline -B 4
    <item name="android:textSize">24sp</item>              # was 28sp

# Shape migration
$ grep cornerSize values/shapes.xml
    <item name="cornerSize">18dp</item>   # Card  (was 24dp)
    <item name="cornerSize">50%</item>    # Pill
    <item name="cornerSize">12dp</item>   # Thumbnail  (was 16dp)
    <item name="cornerSize">16dp</item>   # ThumbnailLarge  (was 22dp)
    <item name="cornerSize">14dp</item>   # Input  (was 18dp)
    <item name="cornerSize">20dp</item>   # Hero  (was 28dp)

# Inline radius migration
$ grep -rho 'cardCornerRadius="[0-9]*dp"' app/src/main/res/layout | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
     42 cardCornerRadius="20dp"   # was 22 (20+24+28 mixed)
      8 cardCornerRadius="16dp"
      8 cardCornerRadius="14dp"
      6 cardCornerRadius="18dp"
      1 cardCornerRadius="12dp"
      1 cardCornerRadius="10dp"
# zero remaining at 24dp or 28dp

# XML health
$ find app/src/main/res -name '*.xml' -print0 | xargs -0 -I{} xmllint --noout "{}" 2>&1 | grep -c error
0   # 243/243 valid
```

### Acceptance checklist
  - [✅] `TextAppearance.PlantCare.Title` now uses `@font/inter` (was `@font/manrope`).
  - [✅] `TextAppearance.PlantCare.Subtitle` `textStyle=bold` removed.
  - [✅] `TextAppearance.PlantCare.Headline` `textSize` 28sp → 24sp.
  - [✅] All 6 `ShapeAppearance.PlantCare.*` cornerSizes tightened.
  - [✅] `PlantCare.Card` cardCornerRadius 24 → 18dp.
  - [✅] 22 inline `cardCornerRadius` values normalised to 20dp baseline.
  - [✅] 243/243 res XML files parse.
  - [⏳] On-device visual confirmation pending Fady's rebuild.

### Files changed

  - `app/src/main/res/values/shapes.xml` (6 ShapeAppearance corner sizes)
  - 22 layout files under `app/src/main/res/layout/` (inline cardCornerRadius normalisation)

### Toolchain note
All edits applied via Python in-place regex on real files (no Edit/Write tool usage on the XMLs). No truncation observed. The corner-radius sweep used a per-file Python loop reading + writing each XML once; XML validity verified after every batch.

## Session: 2026-05-17 (Phase G-polish round 1 — 4 reference-app gap closures)

### Task Completed: G-POLISH-1..4 — Visual identity comparison against three reference apps (Plant Identifier, Set care reminders, Settings) surfaced 12 polish gaps. Tier-1 (highest visual impact, lowest risk) was four items; all four landed in this round.

### Layer: Phase G post-close — premium-feel polish from screenshot comparison.

### Motivation
Fady provided 11 screenshots of the live build plus 3 references. Side-by-side compare showed Phase G's design system is in place, but four micro-decisions break the premium feel:
  1. "Pro werden" CTA renders as dark green pill on light-green banner → low contrast inside the banner. Reference Plant Identifier ships a *white* pill ("Go pro").
  2. Disease-diagnosis screen's Kamera / Galerie buttons use a thin outlined style that floats on the mint-green background.
  3. "Mein Garten" room list uses **ten** different saturated hues (terracotta, navy, mustard, salmon, slate-blue, dark-green, purple, gold, vivid green, pink) — visually disorganised against the unified-palette references.
  4. The big circular CalendarToday IconButton between the week strip and the weather card has no label — purpose is opaque until you tap it.

### Fixes shipped

| ID | Issue | Fix |
|----|-------|-----|
| **G-polish-1** | `heroCta` MaterialButton always rendered green-on-mint because `android:backgroundTint` is ignored by MaterialButton (Material reads only `app:backgroundTint`); the style's `pc_primary` leaked through every time | Rewrote heroCta tag in `include_hero_pro_banner.xml`: `app:backgroundTint="@color/pc_surface"` + `app:elevation="2dp"` + `app:rippleColor="@color/pc_outlineVariant"`. Now matches Plant Identifier's white "Go pro" pill on every screen that hosts the banner (Home, Settings, future paywall preview). |
| **G-polish-2** | `btnCamera` + `btnGallery` in `activity_disease_diagnosis.xml` used `@style/PlantCare.Button.Outlined` → 1dp stroke, transparent fill | Swapped to `@style/PlantCare.Button.Tonal` (already defined: `backgroundTint=pc_secondaryContainer`, dark text, 100dp corner). The two action buttons now read as filled chips matching the rest of the design language; `btnAnalyze` (Filled) above them and `btnHistory` (Text) below keep their pre-existing hierarchy. |
| **G-polish-3** | Ten `room_*` color tokens were ten different saturated hues (`#C47B5A`, `#7E8FB8`, `#5B9BB8`, …) baked into `sage_ic_room_*.xml` drawables → 10 differently-coloured circles in the rooms list. The drawables themselves stay polychrome on intent; the tokens turn into one. | Single-file edit (well, two — light + dark): every `room_*` color in `values/colors.xml` set to `#6B9080` (sage_400, brand medium); every `room_*` in `values-night/colors.xml` set to `#88B0A1` (lighter sage for dark contrast). All 12 drawables continue referencing `@color/room_*` so the change is purely token-level — zero drawable XML touched. Both light + dark have 1 unique room_ value each (was 12 each). |
| **G-polish-4** | The 48dp circular `IconButton` with `Icons.Filled.CalendarToday` between WeekBar and WeatherTipCard had no label — only an Arabic `contentDescription` "اختر الشهر" that screen readers see and sighted users don't. Function (open month picker) was correct; affordance was opaque. | Replaced the IconButton with a labeled pill: `Surface(shape=RoundedCornerShape(24.dp))` wrapping a `Row { Icon + Spacer + Text }`. Reuses existing `R.string.view_full_calendar` ("Voller Kalender" / "Full calendar") so no new strings shipped. Same colour tokens (`iconBgColor` / `iconTintOnPrimary`), same onClick, same Box centring — only the affordance shape + visible label changed. |

### Files changed
  - `app/src/main/res/layout/include_hero_pro_banner.xml` (G-polish-1; 3890 → 4013 bytes; full rewrite via bash heredoc because Edit/Write truncated the file twice at byte 3890 — same Phase-G0.2 toolchain bug logged in the recovery entry).
  - `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_disease_diagnosis.xml` (G-polish-2; 13184 → 13113 bytes after the `s/Outlined/Tonal/` swap + comment; restored from `packaged_res` first because the prior Edit had truncated to 13184 → 13184 with a torn tail at line 285).

### Acceptance checklist (G-POLISH-1..4)
  - [✅] heroCta backgroundTint moved to `app:` namespace; XML valid; elevation 2dp shipped.
  - [✅] btnCamera + btnGallery on Tonal; one legacy Outlined survives elsewhere in same file (legitimate); XML valid.
  - [✅] Every `room_*` light value = `#6B9080`; every `room_*` dark value = `#88B0A1`; XML valid in both.
  - [✅] Month-picker affordance is now a labeled pill, not an opaque circle; reuses `view_full_calendar` string for parity in both DE + EN.
  - [✅] 243/243 res XML files parse; `MainScreenCompose.kt` writes successfully (24435 bytes, 544 lines).
  - [⏳] Visual confirmation on-device deferred to Fady (build + smoke).

### Toolchain note (recurring incident)
Edit + Write tools truncated `include_hero_pro_banner.xml` (twice) and `activity_disease_diagnosis.xml` (once) at deterministic byte offsets mid-attribute — same failure mode that corrupted `strings.xml` × 2 in the G0.2 recovery round earlier today. Workaround applied in both surfaces:
  - For full-file rewrite: bash `cat << 'EOF' > file` heredoc.
  - For targeted edit on an already-truncated file: restore from `app/build/intermediates/packaged_res/devDebug/.../<file>`, then apply a Python regex in-place.
Both workarounds verified clean across this round. Edit/Write should be treated as unsafe for files in this project until the cause is understood. (Hypothesis: a 3890-4096 byte boundary issue in the harness write path, but unconfirmed.)

## Session: 2026-05-16 (Phase G post-close — fix build break inherited from G2.3)

### Task Completed: Build-break repair — `assembleDebug` was broken by Phase G2.3 residue
Two independent regressions surfaced when the scheduled end-of-session task ran `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` for the first time after the Phase G CLOSE:

1. **Invalid XML comment in [fragment_today.xml:22](app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_today.xml#L22).** The Phase G2.3 multi-line `<!-- ... -->` header used a literal `--` inside the comment body (`greetingSubtitle  -- the renderGreeting() Java`). AAPT2 rejects this per XML 1.0 spec §2.5 ("the string `--` MUST NOT occur within comments"). Failed tasks: `mergeDevDebugResources`, `packageDevDebugResources`. Fix: replaced with em-dash `—`.

2. **Dead Java code referencing removed R.id constants in [TodayFragment.java](app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/TodayFragment.java).** The G2.3 author removed the `greetingTitle` / `greetingSubtitle` views from the layout but left the Java fields, `findViewById` calls, the `renderGreeting()` method body, and the helper `resolveDisplayName()` in place — with a comment claiming this was safe because findViewById would "return null". This is wrong: when an `@+id/X` exists in *no* layout, `R.id.X` is not generated at all, so `findViewById(R.id.greetingTitle)` is a *compile-time* error, not a runtime null. Failed task: `compileProdDebugJavaWithJavac` (2 errors at TodayFragment.java:95-96). Fix: removed the two fields, the two findViewById calls, the two `renderGreeting()` call sites, and the now-orphaned `renderGreeting()` + `resolveDisplayName()` methods (the latter was private and used only by `renderGreeting`).

### Layer: Phase G post-close (not a new task — repairing a regression that Phase G10 had deferred to "manual gates")

### Files changed:
  - `app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_today.xml` (1 char: `--` → `—`)
  - `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/TodayFragment.java` (−6 fields/calls, −2 methods, −2 call sites)

### Evidence (grep):
  - `grep -n 'greetingTitle\|greetingSubtitle\|renderGreeting\|resolveDisplayName' app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/TodayFragment.java` → **0 matches** ✅
  - `grep -nP '(?<!<!)(?<!-)--(?!-?>)' app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_today.xml` → **0 matches** ✅ (no invalid `--` inside XML comments)
  - Repo-wide sweep `grep -nP '(?<!<!)(?<!-)--(?!-?>)' app/src/main/res/**/*.xml` → **0 matches** ✅ (no other XML files have the same bug)

  Acceptance checklist:
  - [✅] `assembleDebug` succeeds.
  - [✅] No surviving references to the removed greeting symbols.
  - [✅] No surviving `--` inside XML comment bodies anywhere under `res/`.
  - [N/A] Scheduled-task grep checks (API key / DAO / TFLite / Firestore UID) — none of those task types were touched today; this session was a build-break repair only.

### Build Status: ✅ `:app:assembleDebug` passed (55s; both `assembleDevDebug` and `assembleProdDebug` succeeded).

### Regressions: None. Net code reduction (dead greeting trio + dead `resolveDisplayName` helper that were never visually wired up in Phase G anyway).

### Note for the Phase G CLOSE summary above this entry
Round 40's claim that "the renderGreeting() Java method is null-safe so removing them does not crash" was technically true at runtime — but the comment overlooked that the *symbols* `R.id.greetingTitle` / `R.id.greetingSubtitle` cease to exist when their declaring layout no longer references them, breaking compilation outright. The deferred "batched gate" (`assembleProdRelease` from `build_g0.txt`) had succeeded only because that earlier build ran against a slightly different intermediate source state. Today's run exposed both issues.

Per CLAUDE.md §2 ordering — resume Phase A remaining: **A1 (SecurePrefs unify)** → A3 → A2 → A5 → A4. (Phase F functional bugs and Phase G visual overhaul are both closed.)

## Session: 2026-05-15 round 34 (Phase G3 — Streak Card polish: progress-bar challenges, divider removed)

### Task Completed: G3 — Challenges inside the Streak card now render as a title-plus-progress-bar pair per challenge instead of a single bullet-text line. The internal 1dp `pc_outlineVariant` divider that visually split the Streak card into two blocks in F3.1 is also gone (already removed during G2.3 — confirmed by grep this round).

### Layer: Phase G — Premium Visual Overhaul.

### Files changed (G3):

**G3.1 + G3.2 — TodayFragment.java:**
  - Added import: `com.google.android.material.progressindicator.LinearProgressIndicator`.
  - `renderChallenges(...)` is now a 1-line forwarder that calls the new `renderChallengesG3(...)`. Rationale: the legacy method body contains Java unicode escapes (`✅`, `•`) that resisted in-place patching from the sandbox (the Edit tool kept normalising the escapes). Forwarding preserves the LiveData observer wiring (`viewModel.getChallenges().observe(this::renderChallenges)`) without touching the observer.
  - `renderChallenges_LegacyDoNotCall_(...)` (renamed previous body) holds the pre-G3 bullet-text code for archaeological reference. It is never called; R8 will strip it from the release APK. A future cleanup pass can delete it once we're confident no other build variant still hits it.
  - `renderChallengesG3(...)` (NEW, the actual G3 implementation): for each challenge it builds a vertical LinearLayout containing:
      1. A horizontal header row: title TextView (weight=1) + a right-aligned counter TextView showing `current/target` (BOLD, 13sp, secondary colour). For completed challenges the counter is hidden and the title gets a ✅ prefix.
      2. A `LinearProgressIndicator` with `trackThickness=8dp`, `trackCornerRadius=8dp`, indicator colour `pc_primary` (or `pc_success` when complete), track colour `pc_background_dim`.
  - 14dp spacing between challenge rows, 6dp between header row and the bar inside one row. All measurements driven through the existing `dpToPx()` helper.

**G3.0 — Divider removal (already happened in G2.3, just confirmed):**
  - `app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_today.xml`: the F3.1 `<View android:layout_height="1dp" android:background="@color/pc_outlineVariant"/>` separator that used to sit between the streak header row and the challenges container is gone. The new layout uses 14dp top margin on the challenges container instead, so the streak card now reads as a single cohesive block.

## Session: 2026-05-15 round 29 (Phase F-FIX — Build break repair: 7 duplicate strings from F2.6)
### Task Completed: F-FIX — `mergeProdReleaseResources` failure repaired. F2.6 (round 23) shipped 7 strings whose names already existed in the legacy Settings section of `strings.xml`. AAPT's resource merger refuses duplicates → `BUILD FAILED in 4s` (later 28s with `--stacktrace`). Removed the F2.6 duplicates; kept the pre-existing legacy entries so the legacy `SettingsDialogFragment` still resolves. The new `SettingsFragment.kt` reads the same names → resolves to the same (or near-identical) German/English copy. No code change.

### Layer: Phase F closure repair. Triggered by Fady's `gradlew.bat assembleProdRelease` output on 2026-05-15.

### Context:
Fady ran the release build after F9 closed. Gradle reported:
```
ERROR: ...\values\strings.xml: Resource and asset merger:
Found item String/settings_section_account more than one time
ERROR: ...\values-en\strings.xml: Found item String/settings_section_account
more than one time
```
A Python `re` + `Counter` sweep of both files revealed **7 duplicate string names** in each locale. All 7 originated from the F2.6 round — the legacy SettingsDialogFragment had already shipped strings with the same names back in v0.x, and F2.6 unwittingly re-defined them at the top of the file.

### Duplicates resolved (7 names × 2 locales = 14 deletions):

| Name | F2.6 value | Legacy value | Resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| `settings_section_account` | Konto / Account | Konto / Account | Identical — delete F2.6 |
| `settings_section_help` | Hilfe & Feedback / Help & feedback | Hilfe & Über / Help & About | Slight wording drift — delete F2.6; legacy wording is fine for the new Hilfe card |
| `settings_theme_light` | Hell / Light | Hell / Light | Identical — delete F2.6 |
| `settings_theme_dark` | Dunkel / Dark | Dunkel / Dark | Identical — delete F2.6 |
| `settings_theme_system` | System / System | System / System | Identical — delete F2.6 |
| `settings_language_de` | Deutsch / Deutsch | Deutsch / Deutsch | Identical — delete F2.6 |
| `settings_language_en` | English / English | English / English | Identical — delete F2.6 |

### Files changed:
  - **edit** `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` — removed the 7 F2.6 duplicate `<string>` lines inside the F2.6 sectioned-UI block; replaced with a short comment pointing at the legacy lines that own each name.
  - **edit** `app/src/main/res/values-en/strings.xml` — same 7 deletions in the EN block.
  - **NO Kotlin/Java changes** — `SettingsFragment.kt` references the names, which still resolve, just to the legacy `<string>` definitions further down the file.

### Evidence:
  - Pre-fix: `python3 -c 'Counter(...)' app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` → **7 duplicates** (settings_language_de, settings_language_en, settings_section_account, settings_section_help, settings_theme_dark, settings_theme_light, settings_theme_system).
  - Post-fix: same script → **0 duplicates**. `Total: 553, unique: 553`.
  - Post-fix EN: `Total: 634, unique: 634`.
  - Acceptance:
    - [✅] Both strings.xml files duplicate-free.
    - [✅] Every removed name still exists exactly once in the file (verified by Counter: 553 vs 553).
    - [✅] No Kotlin/Java reference broken (the names still resolve).

### Build Status:
  - Pre-fix: `BUILD FAILED in 28s — Found item String/settings_section_account more than one time` (Fady's terminal output).
  - Post-fix: **NOT yet re-run by Fady** (this session ends with the dedup; Fady needs to retry the build on Windows).

### Action for Fady:
```cmd
cd C:\Users\fadym\Videos\Code\2\Chat 13
gradlew.bat assembleProdRelease
```
Expected: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`. If a new error surfaces, paste the last ~30 lines.

### Regressions:
  - **`settings_section_help` label drift:** new SettingsFragment Hilfe card now shows "Hilfe & Über" (DE) / "Help & About" (EN) instead of "Hilfe & Feedback" / "Help & feedback". Acceptable — both labels describe a section containing contact + about + rate + share + OSS rows.
  - All 6 other dedup'd names had identical values across F2.6 and legacy → zero visible drift.

### Lesson for future rounds:
  - When adding a batch of new strings, run `python3 -c "from collections import Counter; ..."` (or `grep -c '<string name=' | sort | uniq -d`) against the file BEFORE marking the task complete. Adds ~2s, prevents the 28s build failure.

## Session: 2026-05-15 round 24 (Phase F2.7 — Polish: hardware Back, system nav bar tint, rotation safety)
### Task Completed: F2.7 — Hardware Back now pulls the user to Heute before exiting the app. System navigation bar color aligned to the BottomNavigationView surface (`pc_surface`) in both light + night themes. Rotation safety (KEY_SELECTED_TAB) and re-tap idempotency confirmed.

### Layer: Phase F2 (UI redesign — bottom navigation). Sub-task 7 of 8. Small polish round.

### Context:
F2.2 already wired `onSaveInstanceState` for the selected tab and the BottomNavigationView's `setOnItemSelectedListener` naturally suppresses re-tap fires (same-item taps go to `setOnItemReselectedListener`, which is not wired). F2.7 adds the two remaining polish items from the agreed plan: Back-to-Heute behaviour and a seamless system-nav-bar surface that matches the new Bottom Bar.

### Files changed:
  - **edit** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/MainActivity.java` — added `onBackPressed()` override. If the current tab is NOT `nav_today`, the press routes through `selectTab(NAV_INDEX_TODAY)` and is consumed (no `super.onBackPressed()`). On Heute, falls through to the platform default → exit / pop activity.
  - **edit** `app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml` — `android:navigationBarColor` changed from `@color/pc_background` → `@color/pc_surface` so the system gesture/3-button bar visually continues the BottomNavigationView surface (which is also `pc_surface`).
  - **edit** `app/src/main/res/values-night/themes.xml` — same change in dark mode.

## Session: 2026-05-15 round 20 (Phase F2.3 — UnifiedCameraActivity with CameraX preview + Identify/Diagnose mode slider)
### Task Completed: F2.3 — New `UnifiedCameraActivity` (CameraX-powered full-screen preview + segmented mode toggle). FAB in MainActivity now launches it. Both downstream Activities (`PlantIdentifyActivity` + `DiseaseDiagnosisActivity`) accept `EXTRA_PRELOADED_IMAGE_PATH` and skip their own camera step.

### Layer: Phase F2 (UI redesign — bottom navigation). Sub-task 3 of 8.

### Context:
F2.2 wired the FAB to a placeholder Toast. F2.3 replaces that with a real CameraX activity that hosts the "Schiebeschalter" the user described (two-button segmented toggle between **Pflanze erkennen** and **Gesundheit prüfen**, visible while the preview is live). After the user picks a mode and shoots — or picks an image from the gallery — the captured JPG is handed off to the existing PlantNet pipeline (`PlantIdentifyActivity`) or Gemini pipeline (`DiseaseDiagnosisActivity`) via a single shared Intent contract.

### Files changed:
  - **edit** `app/build.gradle` — added 4 pinned CameraX deps (`camera-core`, `camera-camera2`, `camera-lifecycle`, `camera-view` all at 1.3.4). Pinned together to avoid the runtime version-mismatch warning. CameraX 1.3.x is the last line that's still tested against minSdk 24.
  - **new** `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_unified_camera.xml` — `ConstraintLayout` host with `androidx.camera.view.PreviewView` filling the screen, a top scrim (close button + hint), and a bottom scrim with the `MaterialButtonToggleGroup` (singleSelection + selectionRequired, so the user MUST have exactly one mode active), the shutter, and the gallery shortcut.
  - **new** `app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_shutter_button.xml` — layer-list: white inner disc + translucent outer ring (classic shutter look).
  - **new** `app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_camera_scrim_top.xml` — vertical gradient `#99000000 → #00000000` for top overlay.
  - **new** `app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_camera_scrim_bottom.xml` — opposite gradient `#00000000 → #CC000000` for bottom overlay.
  - **new** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/ui/camera/UnifiedCameraActivity.kt` (~290 lines, Kotlin):
    - CameraX `Preview` + `ImageCapture` use cases, `bindToLifecycle(this)` — auto-released on Activity destroy.
    - `MODE_IDENTIFY` (default) / `MODE_DIAGNOSE` constants; `EXTRA_INITIAL_MODE` lets a caller pre-select (used by F2.4's "Mit Kamera erkennen" path).
    - `onSaveInstanceState` persists the selected mode across rotation.
    - CAMERA permission gated through `ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission`. Denied → AlertDialog + deep link to `Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS` + `finish()`.
    - Shutter uses `ImageCapture.OutputFileOptions` writing to `getExternalFilesDir(DIRECTORY_PICTURES)` with `CAM_ID_*.jpg` / `CAM_DX_*.jpg` prefix → fits the existing 30-day cleanup heuristic in `DiseaseDiagnosisActivity` already tolerant of `DISEASE_*.jpg` files.
    - Gallery path: `ActivityResultContracts.GetContent("image/*")` → copy the URI's stream into a new cache file (mirrors the camera-output shape) → route via the same dispatcher.
    - `routeToTarget(file, mode)` builds either `PlantIdentifyActivity` or `DiseaseDiagnosisActivity` intent with `EXTRA_PRELOADED_IMAGE_PATH`, then `startActivity` + `finish()` so Back from the downstream Activity returns to MainActivity (not to a stale camera).
    - Exceptions in CameraX (no back camera on Chromebook, provider failure) routed through `CrashReporter.log` + `R.string.camera_capture_failed` toast.
  - **edit** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/ui/identify/PlantIdentifyActivity.kt`:
    - New `EXTRA_PRELOADED_IMAGE_PATH = "com.example.plantcare.extra.PRELOADED_IMAGE_PATH"` (mirrors the same key on `DiseaseDiagnosisActivity` — symmetric contract; the literal collision is intentional so a single caller can use one key for both).
    - In `onCreate`, after the existing fragment-callback registration, an `if (savedInstanceState == null)` block reads the extra and calls the existing `runPrepareAndApply(Uri.fromFile(f), rawCaptureToDelete = f)` — identical pattern to the Disease activity for consistency.
  - **edit** `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` — registered `.ui.camera.UnifiedCameraActivity` (`exported=false`, `screenOrientation=portrait`, label = `fab_camera_cd`).
  - **edit** `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/MainActivity.java` — FAB `setOnClickListener` Toast → `startActivity(UnifiedCameraActivity)`.
  - **edit** `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` (DE) + `values-en/strings.xml` (EN) — added 8 strings: `camera_hint`, `camera_mode_identify`, `camera_mode_diagnose`, `camera_close_cd`, `camera_shutter_cd`, `camera_gallery_cd`, `camera_permission_denied_{title,body}`, `camera_capture_failed`.

## Session: 2026-05-15 round 17 (Phase F — Bug #10 follow-up: close the optimistic-grant hole + the misconfig-revoke regression)
### Task Completed: F-PRO-VERIFY-HARDENING — bounded the optimistic Pro grant to previously-verified installs; stopped treating CF infrastructure failures as Play rejections

### Layer: Phase F. Verification + completion of round-12's Bug #10 work (simplified user report — "Pro forgeable on rooted phones").

### Context:
Verified round 12's server-side Pro verification. Core verified CORRECT: `verifyPurchase` CF genuinely validates against the Play Developer API; the `firestore.rules` billing block blocks client writes; all client grant paths route through `grantProWithVerification`.

**Two real defects found:**
1. **Optimistic-grant hole** — `grantProWithVerification`'s transient-failure branch did `grantOrRevokePro(true)` unconditionally. A rooted attacker controls the network: forge a local PURCHASED state + block the verifyPurchase endpoint → CF unreachable → transient → permanent optimistic Pro. The exact Lucky Patcher scenario the bug is about stayed open — the attacker just adds "block this URL".
2. **Misconfig-revoke regression** — the CF returns `{verified:false, reason:"server_misconfigured"}` when `PLAY_SA_KEY` is missing; the client treated any `verified:false` as a hard rejection → deploying the CF without its secret correctly set would REVOKE Pro for every paying customer. The CF's own comment ("no security regression / stays provisional") was wrong about the client contract.

### Fix:
**(a) Distinguish "couldn't determine" from "Play rejected"** — `verifyOnePurchaseWithCloud` now inspects `reason` on a `verified:false` response. `server_misconfigured` / `play_api_error` (INDETERMINATE_REASONS) → `null` (transient, no revoke). Only Play's own verdicts (`subscription_expired`, `payment_state_invalid`, `purchase_cancelled`, `purchase_pending`, `purchase_not_found`) → `false` (revoke-eligible). Missing/malformed `reason` → `null`.

**(b) Bound the optimistic grant** — new `ProStatusManager.lastVerifiedMs` / `markVerified`. `grantProWithVerification` stamps `markVerified()` only on a genuine `anyVerified`. The transient branch may now only AFFIRM a previously-verified state, never CREATE one:
  - `lastVerifiedMs == 0` (never server-verified) → `grantOrRevokePro(false)`. This is the line that closes the "block the CF endpoint" forgery.
  - within `VERIFICATION_GRACE_MS` (14 days) → keep Pro (flaky-connection paying user).
  - grace lapsed → revoke (recoverable instantly via Restore Purchases).
  - `ProStatusManager.restoreFromCloud` now stamps `lastVerifiedMs` from `doc.lastUpdatedMs` on a Pro-granting doc (a CF-written doc IS a server verification) so a legit cloud-restored Pro user isn't wrongly revoked by a transient CF outage on a new device's first run.

### Chosen default (noted for Fady to override): `VERIFICATION_GRACE_MS = 14 days`.

### Evidence:
  - Files changed: `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/billing/BillingManager.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/example/plantcare/billing/ProStatusManager.kt`
  - Acceptance criteria:
    - [✅] transient CF failure with `lastVerifiedMs == 0` → no Pro grant (forgery closed)
    - [✅] `verified:false` + infra reason → treated transient, not a revoke (regression closed)
    - [✅] `verified:false` + Play-verdict reason → still revokes (genuine forgery/expiry still caught)
    - [✅] cloud-restored Pro user stamped as verified → not revoked on a transient first-run outage

### Build Status: ✅ `:app:compileDevDebugKotlin` passed (clean — no errors/warnings). Full `assembleProdRelease` not run — two-file Kotlin change, compile verified.

### Regressions: none. The happy path (CF reachable, verified=true) is unchanged. Genuine Play rejections still revoke.

### Residual / not in scope (inherent + deferred):
  - The local `ProStatusManager` pref is still directly editable on a rooted device — unfixable for a purely-local feature gate; server-side verification only hardens the network-block attack.
  - CF deploy + `PLAY_SA_KEY` secret setup (service account + Play Console API access) remain manual — batches with the other deploy work.
